| description = The boss of island five. High resists. Can spawn dual wielding Spiroc Wingblades --or another offhand item like the [[Stein of Flowing Ichor]], which will dramatically increase its melee damage output -- beware! Seems to drop one unique item, one common item, and has a separate chance for the Spiroc Wingblade.

May cast some sort of blind spell on a random target, as well as ranger spells.

Summons a pet.[https://project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=412540]
